Management Plan
- management_plan_main_or_not_recorded:
  - Continue ice therapy for symptomatic relief.
  - Advise easing up on running; avoid running through pain; stop or reduce training if pain requires stopping.
  - Continue or use NSAID analgesia; patient may continue ibuprofen (as used) or a stronger anti-inflammatory to be prescribed — prescription to be sent to pharmacy (specific drug/dose not documented). Do not combine the new anti-inflammatory with ongoing ibuprofen.
  - Arrange referral to physiotherapist for comprehensive assessment and knee examination (provider to send referral).
  - Consider clinical review and imaging if physio assessment indicates or if symptoms worsen.
  - Safety net: seek urgent medical review if persistent swelling, heat or redness of knee, fever, inability to bend/straighten the knee, or systemic unwellness.
